notes: The Quote Editor performs independent protected reads for its Todo, Customer, Fair, Quote, Quote Template, and Template Content dependencies. The route guard and page-level preflight now share one all-required permission contract, preventing partial-permission users from mounting the editor and then generating dependent 403 responses. Ordinary Todo routes remain scoped to todos.read, while quote create/update authorization remains unchanged.
